removed.reason: Timing race, not a native-image gap: AcceptAllCookiesStorage evicts a cookie only when createdAt + maxAge*1000 < now, so a Max-Age=0 cookie read back in the same millisecond is still stored; the native run is fast enough to do so and sees the expired 'basket' cookie. A warn-mode native run reported no missing registration for it, and no metadata or native-image option changes wall-clock timing.
